newsitem.title: FINLAND: Benefon down sharply on weak sales report.
newsitem.headline: Benefon down sharply on weak sales report.

text.p: Shares in Finnish mobile phone maker Benefon Oy fell sharply on Thursday in thin trade after daily business newspaper Kauppalehti reported that early sales of its new GSM phone had been modest, brokers said.
At 1200/0900 GMT Benefon traded at 89.70 markka, down 4.80 markka or more than five percent, but with only 160,000 markka worth of shares traded in a handful of deals.
"It is the Kauppalehti article," one broker said, explaining the share's fall.
Kauppalehti reported that phone retailers had said sales of Benefon's new GSM (global system for mobile communication) phone had been modest during its first month on the market.
It also quoted a Benefon executive as saying sales had been slightly below target.
"The phone's success is considered decisive for the company's future," the paper said.
